_comment: Kojo template `response` (Docs/TextAuthoring/Plan_KojoTemplates.md §7.14): the speaker answers someone - a permission request, a relationship event, a dialogue option. The speaker can always respond here (e.g. a permission granter must be able to act; low consciousness and refusal have their own keys), so there is no status or consent axis and the fallback is a plain unconditional branch with own lines. Every branch is optional except the fallback. Edit freely, then Update store.
label: 回应（许可 / 关系 / 选项）
_comment_bind: Entries proposed for this template (templateBind, reviewed): own entries whose key starts with one of these, without a template field yet.
_comment_fallback: The mandatory last branch: default requirement, no role / master / strong flags, no keepLooking, own lines.
_comment_axes: kind: target (targetBaseID, or targetTags from `tags`), relationship (requireRelationshipTypes; legacy targetTags relationship_*), attitude (requireSelfAttitudeGTE / requireSelfAttitudeKey). examples: suggested branches - other values of the same fields count as the same axis.
_comment_relationshipGroups: Suggested relationship branches (requireRelationshipTypes lists), same as `interaction`. `<type>:A` / `<type>:B` = the speaker is that side of a one-sided type; a plain type = either side.
